The '''2009–10 Marshall Thundering Herd men's basketball team''' represented [[Marshall University]] in the 2009–10 [[college basketball]] season as a member of [[Conference USA]] (C-USA). They played their home games at the [[Cam Henderson Center]] and were led by fourth year head coach [[Donnie Jones (basketball)|Donnie Jones]].
